actions.description: Search the actions available to the current principal and MCP profile.
Return the exact schemas and authorization policy for one available action.
List recent durable action executions in the current workspace.
Read a durable action operation owned by the current workspace.
Wait briefly for a durable operation to change or reach a terminal state.
Request cancellation of a cancellable operation in the current workspace.
List OAuth grants and API-key grants for the current workspace control plane.
Revoke one OAuth client grant for the current user and workspace.
Get the current workspace and its enabled customer capabilities.
Get the current workspace prepaid credit balance.
List recent credit movements for the current workspace.
Get workspace usage, managed cost, and current balance for an optional period.
List agents in the current workspace without their full system prompts.
Get one agent and its complete editable configuration.
Duplicate an agent and its copyable tools, knowledge, evaluations, version, and graph.
Create a short-lived Stripe Checkout handoff for adding workspace credits.
Create a short-lived Stripe Billing Portal handoff for the workspace.
Create a short-lived Stripe handoff for authorizing an auto-top-up card.
List recent Stripe invoices for the current workspace.
Get automatic credit top-up configuration and payment-method status.
Replace the automatic credit top-up configuration for the workspace.
Clear a paused auto-top-up failure state so charging may resume.
List phone and SIP numbers owned by the current workspace.
Get one phone or SIP number owned by the current workspace.
List visible knowledge bases, optionally filtered to one agent.
Get one knowledge base owned by the current workspace.
List documents in a workspace knowledge base.
Get one document from a workspace knowledge base.
Get the ordered transcript and per-turn latency for a workspace session.
